question: If the wife was a witch (Re: Zero-style), what kind of newlywed life would a husband have with each of the seven types of wife?
answer: Typhon: Over here, officer. Sekhmet: Come now, I’ve said it’s time to eat, haven’t I!? When are you coming down!? Ooh, you’re such a loafer! Daphne: The cooking and food and flavor are all perfect, but our Engel’s Coefficient is frightful. (note: seems to refer to percentage of household income spent on food) Carmilla: The neighbors hate us, but all the housework is done perfectly. Minerva: Adores her husband Echidna: Grandma, you know everything.
